name: Lobster

low.description: About 1 medium lobster tail or 3/4 cup cooked meat

siboNotes: Excellent protein choice for SIBO as it's naturally FODMAP-free and easy to digest. Choose simple preparations without high-FODMAP seasonings.
preparationTips: Steam, boil, or grill with FODMAP-friendly herbs like chives or basil
Avoid garlic butter - use garlic-infused oil instead
Season with lemon, salt, pepper, and fresh herbs
Pair with low-FODMAP vegetables for a complete meal
